name: Resistance Band Row
summary: A horizontal pull with a resistance band anchored in front of you. It trains the mid-back and lats and can be done anywhere you can anchor a band.
setup: Anchor the band around a sturdy post, or sit on the floor and loop it around your feet.
Hold the ends with both hands and sit or stand tall with arms straight and the band tight.
Keep your knees slightly bent if seated, and your chest up.
execution: Pull your shoulder blades back and drive your elbows toward your hips.
Bring your hands to the sides of your lower ribs.
Squeeze your back for a moment at the end of the pull.
Return slowly until your arms are straight, without letting your shoulders round.
mistakes: Leaning back to pull: keep your torso still and use a lighter band.
Shrugging the shoulders: keep them down and pull with the back.
Rounding forward on the return: sit tall and keep the chest up.
Unsafe anchor: check the band is secure and not frayed before pulling.

references.title: How to do Resistance Band Rows
